audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Audacity was the ability that lets Qiyana reach you and that "once spent she cannot reach you" — repeated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.
audit.why: Terrashape (W) is also a dash: "Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element", 1100 range on a flat 7-second cooldown. Audacity (E) is 650 range on 11/10/9/8/7. Telling a reader that a spent Audacity strands her is false and it is the kind of false that gets someone killed stepping up.
audit.corrected: All three now say Audacity is the dash onto you and Terrashape is a second, longer dash on 7 seconds — she is never stranded.

audit.whatIsWrong: content spikes[1].text called the wall-dependent, telegraphed ability "her Edge of Ixtal", and wants.foe[2] said "Land Edge of Ixtal on a stationary Neeko for the full combo".
audit.why: Edge of Ixtal is her Q — a 525-range melee swing on a flat 7s. The wall-dependent, telegraphed ability that detonates elements is Supreme Display of Talent (R), 950 range, flat 120s, carrying the knockup and terrain flags. The packet's suspectNames missed this one; it flagged "Pop Blossom's" instead, which is a false positive since that is Neeko's own R.
audit.corrected: Both re-pointed at Supreme Display of Talent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side read "Skill" while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Qiyana/Neeko/Qiyana/Neeko. All seven rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: The content whys already explain each swing from the kit and they hold up: Neeko out-ranges a 525 melee Q early; levels 4-5 flip once Audacity plus a charged element is online; 6 flips back because Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden and her ult needs terrain; the first assassin item flips again; two items favour AoE over single-target burst.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides brought onto the two agreeing sources, with every why and rating rewritten in the same proposal — including 7/10 on the two Qiyana rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why asserted a "3-second knockup" not in Pop Blossom's text, and dosFull[2].d offered a "fifteen-second invitation" after a spent Audacity.
audit.why: Audacity is 11 seconds at rank 1 and 7 at rank 5 — never fifteen. Both numbers were invented.
audit.corrected: Both removed and replaced with the real cooldowns; the spike map now runs on Audacity 11/10/9/8/7, Terrashape flat 7, and Supreme Display of Talent flat 120.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit — catalogued defect 3.
audit.why: All three of her relevant cooldowns are in the kit and two of them are flat sevens, which is exactly the fact that makes waiting out a dash a bad plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: Qiyana is female and the full layer called her "he/his/him" in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.trading, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[1].t, dontsFull[0].t, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[9].t, report[11].t and report[13].t — while the content layer said "her" throughout.
audit.why: champ-gender lists qiyana as female; the kit text says "Qiyana swings her weapon".
audit.corrected: All fifteen regendered as part of their rewrites.

notes: TWO REAL MECHANICAL ERRORS. (1) Three fields claimed a spent Audacity strands her — "once spent she cannot reach you". Terrashape (W) is also a dash, 1100 range on a flat 7-second cooldown, so she is never stranded; all three re-written. (2) content spikes[1].text and wants.foe[2] named the wall-dependent, telegraphed ability "Edge of Ixtal", which is her Q (525-range melee swing, flat 7s). The ability that detonates elements for a stun is Supreme Display of Talent (R), 950 range, flat 120s, carrying the knockup and terrain flags. Both re-pointed. The packet's suspectNames flagged "Pop Blossom's" in whys[4] instead — that is a false positive, it is Neeko's own ultimate. FABRICATED NUMBER REMOVED: dosFull[2].d's "fifteen-second invitation" for an ability that is 11s at rank 1 and 7s at rank 5. Also removed phases[4].why's "3-second knockup". CHART: all seven full-layer sides read "Skill"; content win[] and packet.levelChart agreed on Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Qiyana/Neeko/Qiyana/Neeko, so I brought full onto them with matched whys and ratings and no content win[N] edit was needed. The alternating pattern looks odd at a glance but each swing is explained by the kit and the content whys already argued it. PRONOUNS: fifteen full-layer fields called Qiyana he/his/him against a content layer that said "her". NOT ASSERTED: whether Supreme Display of Talent, which carries the projectile flag, can be intercepted by a Shapesplitter clone — not answerable from the kit.
